content.text:
## Cold-start results — dev.lincforge.benchtarget (Pixel 8 Pro, Android 16, serial <REDACTED-1>)

Each run: force-stopped the app (`nerve_kill`, confirming pid was null), launched it (`nerve_launch`), then read the system-reported `Displayed ... +Nms` line from `ActivityTaskManager` logcat (Android's own cold-start timer from process-start intent to first frame drawn).

| Run | Cold-start time (ms) |
|-----|----------------------|
| 1   | 252 |
| 2   | 226 |
| 3   | 255 |
| 4   | 234 |
| 5   | 235 |

**Median:** 235 ms
**Mean:** 240.4 ms
**Standard deviation:** ≈11.2 ms (population) / ≈12.5 ms (sample, n−1)
**Variance:** ≈125.0 ms² (population) / ≈156.3 ms² (sample)
